User_Objective: Understand what is required and why.
User_Action: Interpret policy and reliefs; consolidate requirements; adjust for risk and EDD indicators.
Experience: Experience hypothesis: Case-by-case interpretation may produce inconsistent requests.
Wait_or_Handoff: Ask Legal about non-AML requirements when needed.
Root_Cause: Policy context and rationale may be fragmented.
Target_Experience: Understand what is required and why.
Product_Action: Prepare a versioned requirements set with policy references and unresolved questions.
Human_Action: MVP: confirm the requirements set. Target: standard execution only within approved authority; exceptions go to the designated expert.

User_Objective: Reuse evidence before asking the client again.
User_Action: Search public and commercial sources for relevant documents.
Experience: Experience hypothesis: Users may switch tools and gather the same information repeatedly.
Information_or_Evidence: External registries, data providers and evidence repository
System_or_Touchpoint: External registries, data providers and evidence repository
Wait_or_Handoff: Sourcing result goes to evidence/gap review.
Root_Cause: Source access and evidence context may be fragmented.
Target_Experience: Reuse evidence before asking the client again.
Product_Action: Retrieve permitted evidence and attach source, retrieval time and entity match.
Human_Action: MVP: review suggested entity matches and reuse. Target: ambiguous matches or access restrictions escalate.

User_Objective: See what is still missing and what blocks progress.
User_Action: Compare available evidence against requirements and identify residual gaps.
Experience: Experience hypothesis: Missing provenance or unclear ownership may prolong gap resolution.
Wait_or_Handoff: Unresolved interpretation goes to the designated reviewer.
Root_Cause: Requirements and evidence may not share a consistent link.
Target_Experience: See what is still missing and what blocks progress.
Product_Action: Match evidence to requirements and propose a residual-gap list with owners and reasons.
Human_Action: MVP: confirm the residual-gap list. Target: complex information gaps require human judgment.

User_Objective: Receive one clear request explaining the remaining information needed.
User_Action: Issue requirements and request outstanding information from the client.
Experience: Experience hypothesis: Repeated or unclear requests may create avoidable client effort.
Information_or_Evidence: Client communication channel and case workspace
System_or_Touchpoint: Client communication channel and case workspace
Wait_or_Handoff: Client response returns to evidence review; Sales/RM involvement to validate.
Root_Cause: Request ownership and requirement rationale may be dispersed.
Target_Experience: Receive one clear request explaining the remaining information needed.
Product_Action: Prepare a consolidated request containing only unresolved gaps and their rationale.
Human_Action: MVP: human approves external release. Target: automatic release remains disabled until explicit policy delegation.

User_Objective: Know which gaps are closed and what happens next.
User_Action: Capture and validate evidence; manage outstanding gaps and the sourcing audit trail.
Experience: Experience hypothesis: Remediation may restart work when prior decisions and versions are hard to find.
Wait_or_Handoff: Make suitable evidence available downstream; keep unresolved blockers visible.
Root_Cause: Weak version/context links may obscure why a gap was reopened.
Target_Experience: Know which gaps are closed and what happens next.
Product_Action: Check evidence completeness and provenance; propose closure or a reasoned rework loop.
Human_Action: MVP: designated reviewer accepts evidence or requests remediation. Target: ambiguous sufficiency or material change escalates; S2 cannot grant trade clearance.
